planets.name: HD 2685 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 2685 with a 4.13-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: HD 2685 b was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 2685. Its orbit and size follow Jones et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
